decision.criteria_text: Students declare a major by form (with a faculty advisor) by 45 completed credits; no application to the major is printed.

lines: Students are required to declare their major by the time they have completed the first 45 credits of their degree. Many students arrive at Lewis & Clark completely undecided, many have some ideas, many say they already know what they will major in. Regardless of which of these categories you fit into, we encourage you to explore our curriculum in your first year.
Fill out and submit the major/minor declaration form on the Registrar’s website. Once the form has been processed by the Registrar’s office, you will be officially declared.

decision.reason: Lewis & Clark College Advising Center: the major declaration process for every major; no CS-specific entry rule is printed.

decision.criteria_text: Admitted students may declare a major on admission; a major must be declared by 45 semester credits; students may change their major at any time.

lines: Students admitted to Linfield will have the opportunity to declare a major, or pre-professional concentration, on admission to the institution. Students who are undecided or exploring will remain as "Undecided" until they declare a major. Students are encouraged to reach out to the academic advising office in addition to working with their faculty advisor for understanding the declaration process.

Once declared, students can change their major at any time. It is recommended that students consult with their current faculty advisor and a faculty advisor from the new department before declaring a new major.

decision.reason: Linfield 2026-2027 catalog Declaration of Major page.

decision.criteria_text: First-year applicants choose their College of Business major on the OSU application.

lines: We have 15 business and design majors, more than any other business college in Oregon. You choose one of these majors when you apply to OSU. Additionally, you receive academic support to explore these degree programs through events and classes in your first year (and beyond) so that, ultimately, your degree aligns with your interests and passions. We are designed to be flexible for you, and many of our students, about a third, graduate with two business majors.

decision.criteria_text: Direct admission into Engineering at OSU-Cascades requires high school pre-calculus or calculus; students not ready for calculus may be admitted to OSU and enter Engineering after meeting the requirement.

lines: New freshmen wishing to enroll in Engineering at the OSU (Corvallis) or OSU-Cascades (Bend) campuses must have taken pre-calculus or calculus in order to be admitted directly into Engineering. Students who are not prepared to take Calculus at OSU in their first term may still be admitted to OSU, but will need to get themselves ready to take Calculus before being admitted into their desired Engineering major. Learn more about this requirement to be admitted directly into an Engineering major.

decision.reason: OSU-Cascades admission requirements page: new freshmen are admitted directly into Engineering when they have taken pre-calculus or calculus.
